card.name: Words pointing to a past time
card.fires_on: Small words right before a time reference to the past or recent past, such as 'this' before week or year, 'last' before spring, or 'may' before 'have' in a guess about earlier events. Seen in news and general web prose.

modes.label: This/last before a time noun
modes.description: A word like 'this' or 'last' that is about to be followed by week, year or spring in a report of something that already happened.
modes.example: The International Society of Hypertension hosted its annual conference in Sydney<< this>> week and its president in Australia, Stephen

modes.label: Speculation about the past
modes.description: 'may' or 'even' before a statement about what people or events did long ago.
modes.example: A similar merger centuries ago<< may>> have created the original Great Red Spot

modes.label: Before an earlier era
modes.description: Words that lead into a historical period or a study from long ago.
modes.example: said doctors were estimating heart disease risk based on a<< study>> conducted six decades ago.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward past-time terms like 'yesterday', 'past' and 'at that time', and away from 'upcoming', 'today' and 'tonight'.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that something happened in the past or recently.
